design_notes: All four countries are one parliamentary vote and one release cluster.

The press release rounds the headline total to €489 million while displayed country amounts sum to €489.2 million. Neither is used as unrounded aggregate gold.
Malta's advance is printed €931.014, whose punctuation is ambiguous in this English release. It is retained in the source but excluded from numeric gold.
One fresh document; do not describe this as a multi-document test without adding verified context.
